wildFacts.text: Schaffhausen is the only canton where voting is compulsory: residents up to age 65 who don't vote pay a CHF 6 fine.
Glarus and Appenzell Innerrhoden still decide cantonal matters at an open-air Landsgemeinde assembly.
FDP won a larger vote share than the Centre but one seat fewer (28 vs 29).

notes: Turnout per IPU: 2,604,984 voters of 5,583,221 registered (46.7%). Voting is not compulsory at federal level; Schaffhausen canton is the exception (constitution Art. 23(2): https://www.fedlex.admin.ch/eli/cc/2003/1135_fga/de). Next election 24 Oct 2027 (IPU). Voting age 18 for National Council: Federal Chancellery https://www.bk.admin.ch/bk/en/home/politische-rechte.html . Council of States rules set by cantons (same page). Schaffhausen compulsory voting also listed by IDEA.
